patchNotes: Yeah lmao, this is gonna be a fat one. Here’s the B-LOW mega patch notes for basically everything we’ve added/fixed in this whole push.B-LOW - Major Update Patch NotesMain Menu / Intro- Added a full animated intro sequence before the main menu.- Added sprite-based logo animation.- Added a two-part B assembly animation.- Added forge/weld-style impact sound when the logo pieces connect.- Added sparks synced to the logo weld.- Added cinematic bass/drop hit on the first full logo reveal.- Added dedicated intro audio.- Added smooth intro-audio fade-out through Animation Events.- Added scene loading through Animation Events.- Added a second scene that automatically plays its own Animator sequence on load.- Added delayed cutscene audio support with configurable start delay.- Synced intro SFX/music timing with visual animation.- Synced the opening riff of the persistent background track with the final zoom into the actual main menu.- Added Flight Sim button.- Flight Sim now uses the existing race-selection/load flow.- Added return-to-main-menu functionality from Flight Sim/race scenes.- Changed the old Quit-style race button so it loads Main-menu instead of closing the game.Persistent Music System- Added persistent background music across scene changes.- Music object now survives scene loads with DontDestroyOnLoad.- Prevents duplicate persistent music objects from stacking.- Added configurable first-play start delay.- Start delay only happens once on the first play.- Added custom looping instead of raw AudioSource looping.- Added smooth fade-out before track end.- Added smooth fade-in when track restarts.- Loop restarts without replaying the initial delay.- Uses realtime timing so music still behaves correctly when Time.timeScale = 0.Accounts / Login- Added local account creation.- Added username field.- Username length validation.- Username status states:  - Name Available  - Name Too Long  - Name Too Short  - Name Taken  - Waiting...- Added password field.- Password field stays unavailable until username is valid.- Added password length validation.- Added Continue gating so account creation only succeeds when both fields are valid.- Added local account persistence.- Added automatic login on future launches.- Added login overlay.- Added typewriter-style:  - Hello (username)...- Added main-menu scene load after successful auto-login.- Added invalid-login handling.- Added encrypted local credential file.- Switched from plaintext file to AES-CBC encrypted credential storage.- Added local credential reset context-menu tool.- Fixed invalid AES key-size issue.- Account username is now reused by the online leaderboard.Online Leaderboard- Added real online leaderboard using Supabase.- Added Supabase project integration.- Added race_leaderboard database table.- Added per-player, per-map leaderboard entries.- Server stores:  - Username  - Map name  - Personal Best  - Total completed race time  - Run count- Added server-side race submission function.- Added real PB handling.- Added real AT handling.- AT = total race time / completed runs.- Added top-five global leaderboard.- Added real player usernames.- Added real global PB values.- Added real average-time values.- Added player global rank.- Added live polling approximately every 1-5 seconds.- Current default refresh can be around 2 seconds.- Added immediate refresh after local score submission.- Leaderboard now reacts when another player beats your score.- If another player moves above you, order updates automatically.- Added Empty... display for unused leaderboard positions.- Empty positions no longer display fake PB or AT.- Added separate local-player row below the top five when player rank is outside top five.- Added separator:  - ----------------- Local player rank can now display values like:  - 6  - 40  - 900  - etc.- Added manual Supabase testing tools.- Added connection test.- Added submit test.- Fixed Unity request checking before SendWebRequest() completed.- Fixed missing Supabase apikey header on actual submissions.- Confirmed Unity → Supabase reads.- Confirmed Unity → Supabase writes.- Added support for manually correcting existing PB values directly in Supabase during development.Leaderboard UI- Added rank positions 1-5.- Added player name.- Added PB and AT beside player name.- Added smaller PB/AT typography.- Added player-specific colors.- YOU uses yellow.- Other usernames use cyan.- Added white punctuation:  - .  - (  - )  - /- PB label uses bright green.- PB time uses darker green.- AT label uses yellow.- AT time uses darker yellow.- Added custom rank gradients.- Rank 1 = gold gradient.- Rank 2 = silver gradient.- Rank 3 = bronze gradient.- Rank 4/5 use custom extra colors.- Rank gradients are assignable directly in the Inspector.- Gradient only affects the rank number instead of recoloring the whole TMP object.- Added multi-digit gradient support so ranks like 128. color every rank digit correctly.- Player row outside top five uses silver gradient.- Added proper per-map PB/AT behavior.Race Timing / PB / AT- PB remains per scene/map.- Added quick dev method to hard-set PB values.- Used to repair invalid 14-second PB caused by old unrestricted super-speed testing.- Added completed-run tracking for AT.- Fixed AT logic so every completed race contributes.- AT no longer only counts runs where a new PB was achieved.- Abandoned/reset runs do not affect AT.- Added local AT total-time and run-count persistence before moving to server data.- Existing race PB formatting retained:  - MM.SS.HH- Existing race TL/PB overview behavior retained.Race Audio- Added ring-pass sound.- Ring sound triggers when a valid ring is actually passed.- Prevents old/inactive ring triggers from making unnecessary sounds.- Added collision impact audio.- Added configurable collision sound.- Added 0.6-second collision audio cooldown.- Prevents collision spam when scraping/bouncing repeatedly.Ship Engine Audio Overhaul- Rebuilt movement/thrust layer.- Added boost behavior.- Added speed-based pitch changes.- Added smooth audio crossfading.- Added smooth pitch transitions.- Added configurable movement fade-in.- Added configurable movement fade-out.- Added idle-under-thrust volume.- Added drift audio.- Added separate hard-stop sound.- Hard-stop sound only triggers after genuine movement followed by near-zero optional flyby/spool accent clips.- Reworked engine sources using the better spacecraft pack.- Moved interior drone/interior machinery sounds into actual idle-body use.- Added Moving.mp3 as the main
